question: In which of the following states is the Rowa Wildlife Sanctuary situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura**__.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The **Rowa Wildlife Sanctuary** is situated in the **Panisagar **Sub-division of North Tripura district.
 
• Tripura is also comprised of another Wildlife Sanctuary situated in **Rajbari National Park.**
